supersedes: version 3 (fresh-bar.json), whose 80-item set was used up by one run (NOT LIVE: 60 vs 53 right, 0 vs 26 harmful, McNemar p = 0.265). Kane's rule is unchanged; only the held-out set is new: 160 questions, none repeating the old 62 or the 80. Scored at c4bce91a, which includes the 'by year' twin fix made after the version 3 run. Committed before any run on fresh2-labels.json.
rule: Jev reads data questions for Pro only when ALL hold on fresh2-labels.json, run once: (1) Jev beats the best non-Jev baseline: more items Jev gets right and that baseline gets wrong than the other way round, with an exact two-sided McNemar test on those discordant items at p < mcnemarAlpha; (2) Jev makes no more harmful mistakes than that baseline, a harmful mistake being a reading settled with confidence that is wrong and would run, so it returns a plausible number (wrongRan). The best baseline is the one with the most right items on this set, ties broken by fewer harmful mistakes. A reading Jev is not sure of must say so and run nothing; it counts as not right and is never harmful. A decline item is right when nothing is settled, and harmful when a reading runs.

baselines.words: the word match (JevQueryWordArm.Read): closest measures and columns by name, exact value matches, top N from the words
baselines.shortlist: the word match with every split replaced by the engine's own split shortlist, top pick first (JevQueryWordArm.ReadShortlist): the redesign's shortlist with no Jev
